title: Hosts — side by side
description: The same reading from every Spark on one chart, to spot the one that behaves differently.

panels.title: All Sparks
panels.description: One row per Spark. Click a name for everything about it. A Spark that dies stays listed as DOWN. Blank means the reading is missing, not zero. Power cuts: shutdowns the SSD was not warned about, over its whole life.

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: Above 1 means tasks are queueing for a CPU.

panels.title: Stalled on memory
panels.description: PSI: share of time every task was blocked on memory.

panels.title: Clock offset
panels.description: Timing-sensitive tests fail on the worker past about 40 ms.
